svg.title: How a statement reaches a namespace
svg.desc: Each statement runs against the session namespace, neo4j unless the session chose another, or against the namespace its USE clause names. neo4j holds the graph; system answers SHOW commands, administration commands and procedure calls; system_ontologies answers only the administration commands, and only from a session set to it. Any other name fails with Graph not found before the statement runs.
